values.heading: What is included
values.body:
This service was seeded by php artisan webx:demo, and it is an ordinary service: edit it, reorder it, publish it, delete it.
Its content is blocks — the same block types the pages of the site are made of.

values.heading: Two orders
values.body: The list of services has an order of its own, and every category has another. Drag a service in the panel with a category chosen and only that category changes.
